subject: SIG: access controls evidence + SCIM attribute clarifications
messages:
From: Alex Taylor <alex.taylor@acme-software.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security@acme-software.com
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG: Access controls — quick evidence request

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for taking our SIG. A few follow-ups after our initial pass: we need concrete evidence and short answers for Access Controls (SSO/SAML, SCIM provisioning, RBAC, MFA, and least-privilege). Specifically:

- SSO/SAML: metadata file and confirmation of IdP testing cadence.
- SCIM: provisioning logs showing user create/update/delete over last 30 days and attribute mapping table (which attribute maps to username/externalId).
- RBAC: current role matrix showing default permissions for operator/admin/developer roles.
- MFA: proof of enforcement (policy + last audit date).
- Least privilege: short write-up of how new project roles are evaluated.

Can you send whatever you can by EOD Monday? If some artifacts are sensitive, a Drive share link or redacted exports are fine.

Best,
Alex
Alex Taylor
Security Engineer, Acme Software
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Taylor <alex.taylor@acme-software.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG: Access controls — quick evidence request

Hi Alex — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Laura and Marissa from Security & Partnerships to help with evidence. Quick notes on scope and timing:

- We can provide SSO metadata (xml) and a summary of our quarterly IdP tests by Monday.
- SCIM provisioning logs: we will export the last 30 days as CSV, but need to redact customer IDs; will include a mapping doc for attributes.
- RBAC role matrix: we have an internal XLSX snapshot (roles + permissions) — fine to share as-is.
- MFA: policy PDF and last internal audit date (2026-07-21).
- Least-privilege process: short statement + link to our internal runbook.

If you need logs with specific timestamps or usernames unredacted for a narrow set of test accounts, let us know which accounts and we can create a scoped export under an NDA. Otherwise we'll send redacted artifacts and an attestation.

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Security & Trust, Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Taylor <alex.taylor@acme-software.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 13 Sep 2026 02:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG: Access controls — artifacts shared

Hi Alex — sharing the requested artifacts. See Drive folder and attached stubs below. If you need full logs for a small set of accounts, request them and we'll produce a scoped export.

Attachments included: redwood_sso_metadata.xml, scim_provisioning_log_20260801-20260901.csv (redacted), rbac-role-matrix-v3.xlsx, mfa-enforcement-policy.pdf, least-privilege-statement.txt
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cDefExample
HubSpot ticket: HBSP-47291

Notes / quick clarifications:
- SCIM attribute mapping: externalId is generated by Redwood as a stable identifier and maps to scim:id. userName maps to the loginName claim (we include the mapping table in the CSV header).
- RBAC: default developer role has token_create:false, model_deploy:false, data_export:false. Operator has token_create:true, but model_deploy requires admin approval.
- MFA: enforced for all console and SSO sessions via conditional policy (OKTA MFA required), last enforcement audit 2026-07-21 (internal audit report available on request).

If anything is missing or you'd like a short walk-through, I'm happy to set a 30-min call.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Director, Security Partnerships
Redwood Inference
From: Alex Taylor <alex.taylor@acme-software.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 13 Sep 2026 04:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG: Access controls — artifacts shared

Laura, Karthik — received, thank you. Quick clarifying question on SCIM: in your CSV the header shows 'id, userName, externalId, emails' — can you confirm whether externalId is returned on all provision events (create/update/delete) and whether it is unique across orgs or scoped per customer? If it's org-scoped we'll need to know for our de-dup logic.

If you can reply or point to the field in the mapping table in Drive, that will close this item for us.

Appreciate the fast turnaround.
Alex
Security Engineer, Acme Software
